nodes.name: build.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Gradle build script for the frisboo-core module declaring Kotlin conventions, Kover, Dokka, Maven publishing, and Arrow/Jackson/Reactor/Spring Boot BOM dependencies.

nodes.name: RequestContext.kt
nodes.summary: Data class carrying per-request contextual metadata assembled from HTTP headers and value objects.

nodes.name: RequestContextAccessor.kt
nodes.summary: Suspension function retrieving the current RequestContext from the coroutine context.

nodes.name: RequestContextElement.kt
nodes.summary: CoroutineContext.Element wrapping a RequestContext so it can be propagated through reactive streams.

nodes.name: RequestContextExtractor.kt
nodes.summary: Object extracting a RequestContext from a Spring ServerWebExchange by parsing standard HTTP headers.

nodes.name: RequestContextWebFilter.kt
nodes.summary: Spring WebFilter that extracts request context and injects it into the Reactor context for downstream handlers.

nodes.name: Command.kt
nodes.summary: Command-side CQRS contracts: Command marker, CommandHandler, and CommandBus dispatch interface.

nodes.name: Event.kt
nodes.summary: Event-side contracts: Event marker, EventHandler, and EventBus publish interface.

nodes.name: Mediator.kt
nodes.summary: Unified Mediator interface dispatching commands, queries, and events through a single entry point.

nodes.name: Query.kt
nodes.summary: Query-side CQRS contracts: Query marker, QueryHandler, and QueryBus dispatch interface.

nodes.name: Serializer.kt
nodes.summary: Generic Serializer contract for byte-array and string serialization/deserialization.

nodes.name: UuidValue.kt
nodes.summary: UUIDValue contract and UUIDCompanion helper interface with create/fromString extension functions for typed UUID wrappers.

nodes.name: CoroutineContext.kt
nodes.summary: Helpers building CoroutineContext and CoroutineScope with SupervisorJob, CoroutineName, and IO dispatcher.

nodes.name: ExecuteWithTimeout.kt
nodes.summary: Suspension wrapper around kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout mapping timeouts and errors into an Arrow Either.

nodes.name: ScopedEither.kt
nodes.summary: Arrow Raise-based EitherContext, EitherCoroutine, and scopedEither/scopedEitherWithError execution helpers.

nodes.name: AppError.kt
nodes.summary: AppError sealed hierarchy: GenericAppError, InvalidVersion, EventVersionError (Lower/Same/Upper), InvalidTransactionError, SerializationError.

nodes.name: SerializationException.kt
nodes.summary: SerializationException extending IllegalArgumentException carrying the target class reference.

nodes.name: DomainEvent.kt
nodes.summary: DomainEvent envelope interface carrying event sourcing metadata (eventId, aggregateId, version, timestamps).

nodes.name: AcceptLanguage.kt
nodes.summary: Inline value class wrapping an Accept-Language string with blank/length validation.

nodes.name: AccountType.kt
nodes.summary: Enum of all account types supported by the core banking system with an all() helper.

nodes.name: ClientId.kt
nodes.summary: Inline value class wrapping a client identifier string with blank/length validation.

nodes.name: ClientIp.kt
nodes.summary: Inline value class wrapping a client IP address string validated for IPv4/IPv6 length.

nodes.name: CorrelationId.kt
nodes.summary: Inline value class wrapping a kotlin.uuid Uuid with generate/of(String)/of(Uuid) factory methods.

nodes.name: Countries.kt
nodes.summary: Enum of 193 ISO countries with code/displayName, lookup helpers, and regional group sets.

nodes.name: Currency.kt
nodes.summary: Enum of global currencies with code/symbol/displayName, fromCode lookup, and regional group sets.

nodes.name: RequestContext
nodes.summary: Data class aggregating per-request metadata derived from HTTP headers and value objects.

nodes.name: toString
nodes.summary: Custom toString rendering requestId, correlationId, tenantId, and principalType.

nodes.name: currentRequestContext
nodes.summary: Suspension function reading RequestContextElement from the current coroutine context.

nodes.name: RequestContextElement
nodes.summary: CoroutineContext.Element key holding a RequestContext instance.

nodes.name: RequestContextExtractor
nodes.summary: Singleton object extracting a RequestContext from a Spring ServerWebExchange via HTTP headers.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.summary: Builds a RequestContext from exchange headers, generating correlationId and requestId when absent.

nodes.name: parseOrNull
nodes.summary: Inline helper parsing a header value into a typed value object, returning null on blank or parse failure.

nodes.name: RequestContextWebFilter
nodes.summary: Spring WebFilter extracting request context and placing it into the Reactor context write.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Marker interface for command messages in the CQRS mediator.

nodes.name: CommandHandler
nodes.summary: Handler interface for a specific command type returning Either<AppError, R>.

nodes.name: CommandBus
nodes.summary: Bus interface dispatching commands to their registered handlers.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.summary: Marker interface for in-process domain events.

nodes.name: EventHandler
nodes.summary: Handler interface for a specific event type.

nodes.name: EventBus
nodes.summary: Bus interface publishing events to all registered handlers.

nodes.name: Mediator
nodes.summary: Unified mediator dispatching commands, queries, and events through a single entry point.

nodes.name: Query
nodes.summary: Marker interface for read-only query messages parameterized by result type R.

nodes.name: QueryHandler
nodes.summary: Handler interface for a specific query type returning Either<AppError, R>.

nodes.name: QueryBus
nodes.summary: Bus interface dispatching queries to their registered handlers.

nodes.name: Serializer
nodes.summary: Serializer contract with deserialize, serializeToBytes, and serializeToString operations.

nodes.name: UUIDValue
nodes.summary: Contract for typed UUID value objects exposing an id property and string() helper.

nodes.name: UUIDCompanion
nodes.summary: Generic companion marker interface enabling create/fromString extension functions.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Extension function creating a typed UUID value from a random UUID via a constructor.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Extension function building a typed UUID value from a nullable string, parsing when non-null.

nodes.name: withCoroutineContext
nodes.summary: Builds a CoroutineContext with SupervisorJob, CoroutineName, and IO dispatcher for a receiver.

nodes.name: withPublisherCoroutineScope
nodes.summary: Builds a CoroutineScope with SupervisorJob, IO dispatcher, and CoroutineName for a receiver.

nodes.name: executeWithTimeout
nodes.summary: Suspension function wrapping a block with a timeout, mapping TimeoutCancellationException and Throwable into Either.Left.

nodes.name: EitherContext
nodes.summary: Interface combining Arrow Raise<Left> with CoroutineScope for scoped error-aware execution.

nodes.name: EitherCoroutine
nodes.summary: Concrete EitherContext delegating Raise and CoroutineScope to provided instances.

nodes.name: serviceScope
nodes.summary: Runs a block within the shared service CoroutineScope augmented with an optional context.

nodes.name: scopedEither
nodes.summary: Runs a block in an Arrow either context over a service scope, returning Either<L, R>.

nodes.name: scopedEitherWithError
nodes.summary: Specialization of scopedEither parameterized by AppError as the left type.

nodes.name: AppError
nodes.summary: Marker interface for all application errors returned through Either lefts.

nodes.name: GenericAppError
nodes.summary: Data class wrapping a generic message, optional cause, and exception class for unknown errors.

nodes.name: InvalidVersion
nodes.summary: Data class for an invalid event version error.

nodes.name: EventVersionError
nodes.summary: Sealed class for event version mismatch errors with Lower, Same, and Upper subtypes.

nodes.name: EventVersionError.Lower
nodes.summary: Event version error when the incoming version is lower than expected.

nodes.name: EventVersionError.Same
nodes.summary: Event version error when the incoming version equals the expected version.

nodes.name: EventVersionError.Upper
nodes.summary: Event version error when the incoming version is higher than expected.

nodes.name: InvalidTransactionError
nodes.summary: Data class for an invalid transaction error with an optional transaction id.

nodes.name: SerializationError
nodes.summary: Data class for a serialization failure carrying a message.

nodes.name: SerializationException
nodes.summary: Unchecked exception raised when serialization or deserialization fails for a specific class.

nodes.name: DomainEvent
nodes.summary: Generic envelope interface for domain events carrying event sourcing and audit metadata.

nodes.name: AcceptLanguage
nodes.summary: Inline value class for Accept-Language header value with validation.

nodes.name: AccountType
nodes.summary: Enum of all supported account types in the core banking system.

nodes.name: ClientId
nodes.summary: Inline value class for a client identifier with validation.

nodes.name: ClientIp
nodes.summary: Inline value class for a client IP address supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

nodes.name: CorrelationId
nodes.summary: Inline value class for a correlation UUID with generate and parse factory methods.

nodes.name: Countries
nodes.summary: Enum of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries with regional groupings and lookup helpers.

nodes.name: Currency
nodes.summary: Enum of global currencies with code, symbol, display name, and regional groupings.
